class.name: OcgXcafdocAssemblyitemref
class.brief_description: An attribute that describes a weak reference to an assembly item or to a subshape or to an assembly label attribute.
class.description: ! An attribute that describes a weak reference to an assembly item ! or to a subshape or to an assembly label attribute.

method.name: IsOrphan
method.description: Checks if the reference points to a really existing item in XDE document.

method.name: HasExtraRef
method.description: Checks if the reference points on an item's shapeindex or attribute.

method.name: IsGUID
method.description: Checks is the reference points to an item's attribute.

method.name: IsSubshapeIndex
method.description: Checks is the reference points to an item's subshape.

method.name: GetGUID
method.description: Returns the assembly item's attribute that the reference points to. If the reference doesn't point to an attribute, returns an empty GUID.

method.name: GetSubshapeIndex
method.description: Returns the assembly item's subshape that the reference points to. If the reference doesn't point to a subshape, returns 0.

method.name: GetItem
method.description: Returns the assembly item ID that the reference points to.

method.name: SetItem_1
method.description: Sets the assembly item ID that the reference points to. Extra reference data (if any) will be cleared.

method.name: SetItem_2
method.description: Sets the assembly item ID from a list of label entries that the reference points to. Extra reference data (if any) will be cleared.

method.name: SetGUID
method.description: Sets the assembly item's label attribute that the reference points to. The base assembly item will not change.

method.name: SetSubshapeIndex
method.description: Sets the assembly item's subshape that the reference points to. The base assembly item will not change.

method.name: ClearExtraRef
method.description: Reverts the reference to empty state.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream

method.name: Get
method.description: Finds a reference attribute on the given label and returns it, if it is found

method.name: Set_1
method.description: Create (if not exist) a reference to an assembly item.

method.name: Set_2
method.description: Create (if not exist) a reference to an assembly item's label attribute.

method.name: Set_3
method.description: Create (if not exist) a reference to an assembly item's subshape.
